page_note: 这是一页NERC《2024 Long-Term Reliability Assessment》正文页，左栏为天然气发电与管道容量的论述文字，右栏含一张编号Figure 16的堆叠柱状图（美国年度天然气管道容量新增，Interstate/Intrastate，2017–2024）。

heading.title: Annual U.S. Natural Gas Pipeline Capacity Additions by Type (2017–2024)

components.evidence: each year is one bar with a dark 'Intrastate' base and light 'Interstate' segment above
'Interstate' and 'Intrastate' swatches in a row under the year axis
'Pipeline Additions' set vertically along the left value axis
axis ticks are bare 0, 5 ... 30; 'Bcf/d' appears only in the caption
faint horizontal rules at 5, 10, 15, 20, 25, 30; no vertical rules
left column of body text ('The 2024 LTRA projects...') runs level with the plot

new_components.name: source_in_caption_parenthetical
new_components.evidence: caption ends '(Source: U.S. Energy Information Administration)' inside the bold figure caption, no separate source line
new_components.why_it_matters: 来源与单位都被并入同一行粗体标题，解析器导出时容易把'Bcf/d'和来源一起当作标题文字，导致单位无法作为独立字段与数值绑定。

new_components.name: empty_series_slot_in_stack
new_components.evidence: 2022 bar shows only light Interstate; 2024 shows only a sliver of dark Intrastate
new_components.why_it_matters: 某些年份某一系列为零或极小，表格里该单元格是缺失还是零无法从图上区分，读值时需明确该槽位是否存在。

difficulty_notes: 图上没有任何数值标签，刻度只有0/5/10/15/20/25/30，5个单位约占74像素，即1像素≈0.07 Bcf/d。要判定的十个值里有1.2、1.6、4.2这类小段，5%容差分别只有±0.06、±0.08、±0.21，几乎等于1–3像素，靠插值读不到；而Interstate段（16.2、21.2、10.8、8.7、8.5）并非从零起算的柱长，必须用堆叠顶端减去深色底段两次读数相减，误差叠加后更难落在5%内。相比之下寻址只需'2017'+'Interstate'两个键，标题为粗体独立行，第3、4步都不是瓶颈。
